description: nic.sv:487 unicast pid = {8'h00, tptr+idx} truncates 11-bit tptr to 8 bits; tptr>=256 wraps and collides. Fires only at VCS>=4 (longer traces); VCS=2 stays under 256. Contrast proof: b10_vc1 (VCS=2) passes with 71,832 flits vs b10_vc2 (VCS=4) failing at 578. Issue veritx-research-ee61.
resolution: Widen pid field to 16 bits; verification needs a VCS=4 build that survives this box (0344 wall); route-table path may bypass at VCS=2.

description: -DTWO_DIE_ROUTE_TABLE binary (d7fce0b, vbuild_table) exits before flit replay. Test 1 self-exited 391s, 0-byte rtl_flits; smoke run never updated rtl_flits.txt mtime -> died before noc_tb.sv:205 fopen (pre-replay: route_*.hex/trace_n*.hex load or cold pass). Suspect $fatal in route_*.hex loader. Issue veritx-research-f038.
resolution: Capture run with stdout/stderr to pin the fatal line; verify route_*.hex format matches loader.

title: F14 resolved: deadlock persists through route table
rationale: smoke_capture.log (10:40) shows the -DTWO_DIE_ROUTE_TABLE binary ran the full 7999-cycle window + 32768-cycle drain: injected=1696 ejected=0, zero ejects in all PROG/DRAIN lines, $fatal noc_tb.sv:324. Route table does NOT break the 1-VC bridge cycle; supersedes the earlier 'pre-replay crash' hypothesis (0-byte rtl_flits was zero ejects, not a crash).
